LPG dealers announce nationwide strike from Nov 16

By: Rizwan Alam October 31, 2026

The Pakistan LPG Marketers Association has announced a nationwide strike from 16 November over its concerns about a new pricing formula.

The association's senior vice-chairman, Ali Haider, said LPG sales across the country would stop if the authorities failed to accept its demands within 15 days.

He said the new formula would make it impossible for dealers to continue operating and urged the government to hold talks with the association.
